environment.pins_basis: Amendment A: scikit-learn pinned to the original run's recorded version 1.7.1 (evidenced by InconsistentVersionWarning in the pre-execution pickle audit); lightgbm 4.5.0 / pandas 2.2.3 / numpy 2.1.3 / joblib 1.4.2 are the tag's own backend pins (original LightGBM version is not recorded in its pickles)

procedure.command: python backend/ml/train_73_features.py  (run from the extracted tag root; trainer unmodified)

gate1_feature_count.detail: all 11 categories report 73 features in both runs (trainer log lines); dead yoy_change column (all-NaN in 4 pure-daily categories) still counted, as in v1

gate2_determinism.verdict: FAILED byte-exactness, diagnosed benign and quantified: LGBM bit-identical across runs (all prediction deltas 0.0); RandomForest differs only at last-bit float-scheduling noise (~1e-12 absolute on predictions in the thousands; metric payloads differ ≤ 2.1e-3 ppm, last 1–2 digits). Same venv, same machine, identical invocations. Reported as failed under the frozen byte-exact rule, with the noise envelope recorded — not silently redefined as a pass.
gate2_determinism.rf_noise: max |Δ| run1 vs run2 across categories: 5.5e-12 (predictions), metric payloads differ in 19 of 44 entries at ≤ 2.1e-3 ppm

gate3_pickle_equivalence.summary: SPLIT BY DATA FAMILY. Family B (4 pure-daily categories: electronics, furniture, health, sporting) — RUN-LEVEL recovery proven: committed pickles reproduce the committed data exactly (LGBM embedded metrics match to 0.0; RF to ≤ 5e-14, last-bit parsing noise). Family A (7 mixed-grain categories) — committed pickles do NOT reproduce on the committed CSVs: prediction deltas of hundreds to thousands (e.g. total_sales RF max|Δ| 1.04e4); the committed Family A models were trained on earlier, different data (pickles 2026-01-12, tag commit 2026-10-02 — a nine-month drift window). For Family A the recovery is protocol-level only.

classification: split: run-level for the 4 pure-daily categories (Family B); protocol-level-only for the 7 mixed-grain categories (Family A — committed models predate the frozen data); overall NOT a full run-level recovery, reported exactly as measured
run2_metric_delta_note: RandomForest entries may differ from run1 in the last 1–2 digits (float-scheduling noise, quantified in gate_outcomes); LGBM entries identical
